response.sql: WITH per_item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(ili.product_price * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_line_items_per_order_item FROM per_item;
